channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Chiefs acquired G Joshua Ezeudu from the Giants in exchange for a 2028 seventh-round pick.
item.description: The Chiefs add interior offensive line depth in Ezeudu, who was on the roster bubble for the Giants offensive line. The 26-year-old was a third-round pick of the Giants in 2022 and appeared in 33 games over the course of his New York tenure. He becomes guard depth for the Chiefs as roster cut-down day nears.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: ESPN’s Mike Reiss says Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez “expressed disappointment” in his contract extension negotiations.
item.description: Gonzalez and the Pats have continued negotiations on a top-of-the-market extension for the 24-year-old cornerback, but are not yet close to an agreement. Fellow corner Devon Witherspoon signed his deal earlier in August but Gonzalez has still yet to sign a similar or slightly larger deal. He said, “it’s frustrating, but I’m focused on the season.” A deal can still come before the Patriots play in Week 1 but it’s clear Gonzalez is disappointed in negotiations despite not holding out.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Eagles TE Eli Stowers (hamstring) missed his second straight practice Tuesday.
item.description: Stowers missed his second straight practice Tuesday as he deals with a hamstring issue. There is no indication this is a major injury yet, but something to keep an eye on as the Eagles prepare for preseason Week 3. The rookie second-round pick has struggled in camp and comes into the NFL as a raw tight end prospect. Don’t expect the Eagles’ tight end rotation to change drastically should Stowers miss time in the 2026 regular season.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Rams EDGE Myles Garrett (knee) did not participate in Tuesday’s practice.
item.description: Checking in on the star pass-rusher heading into the third preseason week, Garrett (knee) still has not practiced since early August. He is experiencing swelling in his knee and head coach Sean McVay continues to downplay his absence. It’s possible this is just veteran load management; we still expect Garrett to be ready for Week 1, though his absence is becoming more and more notable as the season inches closer.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: J.J. McCarthy and Carson Wentz split the second-team reps at Vikings training camp on Tuesday.
item.description: The Vikings spent a lot of energy having a pretend quarterback competition between McCarthy and Kyler Murray this offseason, but at least it kept them fresh for this second pretend competition where McCarthy will push Wentz for second-team duties. McCarthy is an obvious trade candidate and it would be surprising if he was higher than the third-team quarterback to open the season in Minnesota. One of these quarterbacks is more reliable than the other and somehow that quarterback is Carson Wentz.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Mike Evans (groin) did not practice Tuesday.
item.description: Kyle Shanahan indicated Evans should be back to practice next week before leaving for Australia. The line between “Evans is being treated very carefully” and “Evans is always hurt” has been blurred for a few years now, but it doesn’t seem like he’s in any danger of missing time yet.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Seahawks placed S Bud Clark (ankle) on season-ending injured reserve.
item.description: It’ll be a total redshirt year for the 64th overall pick. Seattle also placed OL Mason Richman on injured reserve.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Commanders signed LT D.J. Humphries to a one-year contract.
item.description: Humphries appeared in eight games with the Rams last year, mostly as a reserve. His last real chance to start came when the Chiefs turned to him in 2024 and he was disastrous there, though admittedly he was playing through a hamstring injury. He’s a veteran depth add here as the Commanders try to muddle through life without Laremy Tunsil.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Ty Chandler (knee) will miss the 2026 season.
item.description: Tough break for the 28-year-old back. He didn’t figure to be a major part of the Saints backfield conversation, but he had a shot at a roster spot if healthy. He’ll likely need to prove he’s healthy before signing on for another shot elsewhere in 2027.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Jets special teams coordinator Chris Banjo said Jason Sanders has won the team’s kicking job.
item.description: The 30-year-old veteran who missed all of last season due to a hip injury was released from the Giants’ competition in June and caught on with the Jets afterwards. “Jets kicker” is not traditionally a very valuable fantasy role, and this year, that will probably remain the case.-Rivers McCown
